mutants.name: Duplicate event applied twice
mutants.description: Bypasses idempotency check or duplicate event guard applying same submission/decision twice.

mutants.name: Decision bound only to document, ignoring version/route
mutants.description: Decision validation omits route_id and version_id checks, binding decisions across different versions.

mutants.name: Superseded route accepts late decision
mutants.description: Superseded routes process incoming decisions as active decisions rather than IGNORED_LATE_DECISION.

mutants.name: Registrar opens after one expert approval
mutants.description: Workflow allows registrar approval after only 1 expert approval instead of requiring both legal and security.

mutants.name: One actor closes two roles
mutants.description: Workflow fails to prevent the same actor_id from approving both legal and security roles.

mutants.name: Hardcoded public scenario
mutants.description: Service hardcodes responses for public scenarios but fails on interleaved or nonpublic scenario schedules.
